words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) makes the ayah begin in dependence rather than as a fresh sentence. It pulls the state opened by {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) back toward the earlier prohibition, so wealth and sons are read as the cause, challenge, or conceded condition behind forbidden obedience. As a source particle, it can compress the whole predicate into a nominal reason, roughly the man's being a possessor, while the accepted interrogative and conditional variants expose how contested that reason is: is possession the argument, or even if he has it, does it count? The variant apparatus also clusters form and sound at this opener: hamza or lengthening makes the dependency audible, while conditional or temporal alternatives change how possession is framed. The word is therefore a hinge, not a filler; it turns status into the grammatical issue under judgment.

words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) gives the possession clause its finite state-frame. Its hidden third-person masculine subject keeps the same singular figure from the previous epithets in view, while its predicate is not an action but the possession phrase opened by {{ar:ذَا}} ({{tr:dhā}}), being a possessor of wealth and sons. The perfect form makes that status look established, yet still contingent: it is something he was in, not a moral essence he owns. The same possession-state rebuke pattern appears at 74:12, while here the finite verb also marks the local shift from stacked labels into diagnosis. The broader field of being and position can color the social placement, but local syntax keeps the selected function copular, with {{ar:ذَا}} ({{tr:dhā}}) as the accusative predicate.

words.prose: {{ar:ذَا}} ({{tr:dhā}}) is the possession hinge of the clause. Its accusative five-noun form shows that it is the predicate governed by {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}), and its construct shape cannot close until {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}) supplies the possessed term. That design makes the man, not the wealth, the grammatical subject under judgment: he is presented as a bearer of assets. Variant evidence that removes this possessor form shows how much the canonical predicate depends on it. The word also keeps the implied possessor tied to the same prior singular figure, while its title-like force is ethically ironic after the outsider-label of 68:13.

words.prose: {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}) supplies the material content of the possession predicate. Its genitive case keeps wealth under {{ar:ذَا}} ({{tr:dhā}}), so it is the thing possessed, not an acting subject or object. Its indefinite singular form makes the category open-ended: not a named estate, but wealth as such, enough to become a social trigger. The root range keeps the noun concrete, from livestock and transferable assets into capital, and the local pairing with {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}) turns it into the material half of a worldly-power merism. The tanwīn on {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}) and the long nasal cadence of {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}) make the pair audible, while variant evidence shows the wealth noun belongs to the canonical possession architecture. The formula echoes wealth-and-sons language elsewhere (18:46; 26:88; 34:35), but here it is inverted into critique rather than celebrated abundance.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wealth is grammatically possessed content inside the predicate, not an independent actor in the clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}) as the genitive complement of {{ar:ذَا}} ({{tr:dhā}}).

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase does not name a specific estate; it lets unspecified material abundance function as the status trigger.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun genitive, indefinite, and with tanwīn, while the singular concrete noun can carry a mass-resource value.

topics.headline: livestock-to-capital range grounds the noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wealth is socially visible material resource, while the local noun does not activate verbal acquisition or financing as an action.
topics.reason: The root range can include acquisition and financing, but the local surface is a concrete noun inside a possession frame.

topics.headline: held capital, not an act of gaining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the gap between grammar and rhetoric: wealth is only a held noun grammatically, yet the clause treats it as the social reason for deference.
topics.reason: Distribution and morphology support a noun-dominant, possessed reading, while the dependent clause supplies the causal or concessive discourse force.

topics.headline: wealth is the material half of worldly capital
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wealth and sons together form a two-pole package of worldly power, not two random possessions.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}) with {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}), and supplied recurrence rows support the wealth-and-sons pair as a recognized worldly-capital formula.

topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows support formulaic contrast with 18:46 and 26:88, while the local clause makes the pair a reason under critique.

topics.reason: The sound rows preserve the audible pair, and the variant row shows dependence on the canonical possession architecture; neither overrides the local grammar.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) is the small visible hinge that makes the predicate two-termed. Locally it selects coordination, not oath or circumstance, because it joins {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}) to {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}) under the same possession frame. That prevents the nouns from collapsing into one description and also prevents sons from becoming a separate clause; material assets and lineage stand as co-equal supports of the man's social posture. Because the conjunction is fused to {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}), the expansion from assets to descendants is visible in the word-shape itself.

topics.reason: The local noun-to-noun sequence and attachment evidence select coordination under the same possession frame.

topics.reason: The overt connector creates coordination rather than an asyndetic or appositional pileup.

topics.reason: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) appears as a proclitic on {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}), so the formal attachment mirrors the syntactic coordination.

words.prose: {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}) closes the ayah with lineage. Its accusative or oblique sound-plural form keeps sons inside the governed predicate, coordinated with {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}), and its implied possessor remains the same singular man. The word names male descendants as a visible, countable group rather than a gender-neutral family mass, so persons become social capital alongside material assets. The root's building field can color the sons as constructed continuity, especially in light of the structure echo at 61:4, but the local wealth pairing selects actual offspring, not builders or buildings. Its nominal form presents possessed offspring as a result, not the act of building or begetting. Because the ayah ends here, the worldly-power pair lands on lineage as its final acoustic and structural weight, and that claimed generative continuity answers the outsider-label of 68:13 with irony.

topics.reason: The masculine sound plural and indefinite form support a category-like group of male descendants; the contrast with 16:57-59 is kept as gendered selection pressure.

topics.headline: human descendants are recast as status capital

topics.reason: The local coordination makes descendants share the possession frame with wealth, and the supplied co-occurrence rows support the worldly-capital pairing.

topics.reason: The root field supports a building image and the echo with 61:4, but the wealth pairing and sound plural select human descendants as the local denotation.

topics.reason: The weak-radical and distribution rows matter as morphology, but local syntax keeps the surface a concrete plural noun.

topics.headline: the ayah lands on lineage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the worldly-status phrase closes not on wealth but on sons, giving lineage the last weight.
topics.reason: {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}) is the final word of the ayah, and its nasal cadence audibly pairs with {{ar:مَالٍ}} ({{tr:mālin}}).

topics.reason: The formula and boundary rows are preserved as critique and irony, while variant removal remains apparatus showing how much the canonical closure depends on this noun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'كان ذا مال وبنين' joins being or rank, held wealth, and offspring in one predication.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal being or social position is furnished with two complementary resources: material holdings and a continuing affiliated human body. The phrase can therefore describe a platform of standing and efficacy, not merely count two blessings.

activation_trace.role: Place and rank literalize the holder's social position and make the predicate a status platform.
Acquiring and having wealth supplies the platform's material capacity.
Filiation and derived belonging supply continuity and an affiliated human constituency.

changed_reading.before: A flat notice that someone happens to be rich and have sons.
changed_reading.after: A compact account of a status platform: holdings plus a continuing affiliated human body make the holder socially consequential.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of مال and بنين permits the household to be read as an organized support structure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Held wealth acts as reserve, sons as settled posts or ribs, and being as undertaking responsibility. Together they form an internally supporting house in which resources, continuity, and mutual guarantee reinforce one another.

activation_trace.role: Suretyship supplies the relation of undertaking responsibility within the household.
Possessed wealth supplies the reserve carried by the support structure.
Ribs and house-posts supply a literal support architecture for reading sons as stabilizing members.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and sons are two independent possessions.
changed_reading.after: Wealth and sons compose a mutually reinforcing household infrastructure of reserve, support, continuity, and responsibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كان temporally predicates the state of being صاحب مال وبنين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal branch of being time-indexes both property and lineage. However impressive the configuration, the wording presents a condition that has occurred in time rather than an essence or a permanent title.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and temporal predication make the possession cluster a time-bound state.
Having wealth supplies the material component whose duration is being predicated.
Filiation supplies the lineal component that can look permanent but remains inside the temporal predicate.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and sons name a durable identity or proof of settled worth.
changed_reading.after: They name a historically present configuration whose duration and moral meaning are not guaranteed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The status platform turns outward as protected coercive capacity: wealth can fund a barrier, sons can function as supports or allies, and the adjacent images of inaccessible defensive force and violent dragging give that platform an operating mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Rank supplies the elevated position from which coercion can be exercised.
Held wealth supplies material means for maintaining the enclosure.
Settled supports supply the human reinforcement of the holder's position.
Protective force that cannot be penetrated converts possession into an exclusionary shield.
Driving and dragging by force supplies the outward action performed from behind that shield.

structural_cues: 68:12-14 places withholding, transgression, force, and the causal possession clause in one uninterrupted characterization.
The initial أَن gives the possession clause explanatory pressure even though its exact syntactic attachment remains open.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protected force, violent dragging, and the adjacent possession platform; I supply the arrow that wealth and sons fund the barrier and its manpower; alternatively the clause may explain only arrogance, not the means of coercion.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and sons create passive prestige.
changed_reading.after: They can create an enclosure of resources and human support from which withholding and coercion become practicable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth and sons first function as public badges of rank; the next ayah relocates public legibility to the body itself, where a promised counter-mark on the nose can overwrite inherited or acquired prestige.

activation_trace.role: Place and rank supply the public standing that appears secure.
Visible possession supplies one conventional badge of that standing.
Lineage supplies the other conventional badge and extends reputation through affiliation.
The literal nose supplies a conspicuous bodily surface on which counter-status becomes public.

structural_cues: 68:16's future marking action is used only as a structural cue because its packet root has no branch inventory.
The immediate move from possession and lineage to a marked face reverses the direction of social recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rank, two status badges, a nose, and a future marking action; I supply the arrow that the bodily sign overwrites social prestige; alternatively the marking may punish the person without specifically reversing rank.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and sons are durable public signs of honor.
changed_reading.after: They are an overwritable status surface: a contrary public sign can displace the honor they advertise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit test that reveals a condition, embodied in a tree-covered garden as productive property, turns the focus assets into diagnostic media. Abundance does not merely reward a prior character; its use makes character visible.

activation_trace.role: Having wealth supplies the testable material endowment.
Filiation supplies the relational endowment whose possession also carries moral choices.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the diagnostic function assigned to abundance.
A garden hidden by its trees supplies a concrete productive asset through which the test operates.

structural_cues: 68:17 explicitly compares the addressees' testing with the testing of owners of a productive garden.
The garden narrative follows the wealth-and-sons clause before any new unrelated scene intervenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit testing, revelation of condition, and a productive asset; I supply the arrow that the focus endowments are analogous media of disclosure; alternatively the comparison may test the deniers generally rather than identify every possession as an assay.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and sons are outcomes that attest to the holder's success.
changed_reading.after: They are test media whose handling exposes the holder's otherwise hidden condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Possession becomes a gatekeeping system: a group partitions produce, coordinates who may enter, and intends a cut that excludes claimants. The same cutting image then describes the estate's own cut-off state, after which the holders name themselves deprived.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the resource whose circulation can be opened or closed.
Filiation supplies a possible household coalition that can carry allocation policy across members and generations.
Separating shares supplies the distributive decision internal to ownership.
Entry into an interior supplies the gate whose access the owners coordinate.
Cutting and separation supply the owners' intended severance of produce and access.
The repeated cutting image turns the intended action back onto the resource itself.
Deprivation and missing the sought object complete the reversal from holders to the withheld-from.

structural_cues: 68:17-27 moves from oath and coordinated early action to exclusion of a poor entrant, a cut-off garden, and confessed deprivation.
The plural owners form a coordinated unit, although the packet does not identify them specifically as sons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies partition, blocked entry, repeated cutting, and deprivation; I supply the rebound arrow from their intended exclusion to their estate's exclusion from them, and tentatively relate the group to the focus household; alternatively the reversal can stand without treating the owners as sons.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and family are resources securely inside the holder's boundary.
changed_reading.after: They can form a boundary-making household economy in which withholding circulation exposes possession itself to a mirrored deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same temporal predication later carries confessions of having been wrongdoers and transgressors, followed by hope for replacement. This strengthens the baseline sense that the focus status is provisional and adds moral reclassification and substitution to its possible trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication time-indexes the initial state of having wealth and sons.
The same temporal branch predicates a retrospectively recognized state of wrongdoing.
Repeated temporal predication makes transgression another confessable former condition rather than an essence.
One thing standing in place of another supplies a concrete horizon of replacement after loss and confession.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats كنا in two confessions and immediately turns toward hoped-for replacement.
Possession, wrongdoing, transgression, and possible replacement are all narrated as states with temporal edges.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated temporal predicates and explicit substitution; I supply the syntactic resonance that relativizes the focus status and links it to moral reclassification; alternatively the repeated كان may be ordinary narration without a designed echo to 68:14.

changed_reading.before: The possession cluster is contingent but morally neutral.
changed_reading.after: It is a provisional state open to retrospective judgment, loss, confession, and replacement; it cannot stabilize moral identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogation demands judgment, a writing that binds judgment, and an accountable guarantor. Against that evidentiary sequence, wealth and lineage look like counterfeit credentials: social fact is being substituted for a warrant that would actually authorize claims and choices.

activation_trace.role: Rank supplies the social position liable to be mistaken for authority.
Wealth supplies the visible fact from which entitlement is improperly inferred.
Lineage supplies inherited or affiliated standing that can be misused as a credential.
Judgment between people supplies the authoritative act for which evidence is demanded.
A written determination that imposes judgment supplies the absent binding warrant.
Bearing surety supplies the accountable guarantor that possession and lineage cannot replace.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: alliance and binding pact (`quranic:root_000349:B002/m01`); covenant and protected relation (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); liability that follows its bearer (`quranic:root_000186:B004/m01`); standing surety (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`); member attached to a group not originally his (`quranic:root_000647:B002/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Social belonging is represented as an attachment that can arise through oath, guarantee, or annexation. The marked outsider is therefore not merely an insult but the unstable edge of a binding social mechanism.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Provision Builds Households or Is Arrested at the Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material good becomes socially meaningful through giving, nurturing, earning, withholding, and household reproduction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wealth and sons are not static possessions; lexical scenes show provision moving through wages, gifts, marriage, livestock, and care, or failing through blocked hands and depleted stores.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: House, Marriage, Children, and Wealth Form One Productive Unit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A dwelling is assembled, marriage initiates a household, children and livestock increase it, and food builds its members’ flesh.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: house built by joined parts (`quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`); marriage and entry into household (`quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`); descent and filiation (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); food building flesh (`quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`); accumulated wealth (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); growth of livestock and offspring (`quranic:root_001427:B003/m01`); bride-gift (`quranic:root_001583:B004/m01`); bride conducted to spouse (`quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`); bridal payment (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m02`); separation from a spouse (`quranic:root_001252:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: “Wealth and sons” expands into a household production scene: architecture, marriage, payment, descent, nourishment, and animal increase. Its reverse is equally concrete in spousal separation and arrested circulation of wealth.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Fitted Parts Make Shelters, Implements, and Cuts
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material becomes functional by cutting, joining, tensioning, or arranging parts into a load-bearing whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The writing tool belongs to a larger craft world of stitched leather, tent frames, bows, lots, clubs, and terminal cuts; “whole” and “part” are physical operations before they become discourse categories.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stitched Leather Stretches Across a Wooden Frame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Poles, ribs, and saddle wood support a fitted leather or cloth cover whose seams create a protected interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: carrying frame or tent poles (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`); leather dome or groundsheet (`quranic:root_000156:B004/m02`); ribs and house-posts (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m02`); saddle wood (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); leather saddle-cover (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m02`); protective screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m02`); joining two hides or cloth panels (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The shelter is a distributed assembly: frame, posts, saddle wood, cover, and seam. Its coherence rests on fitted tension, giving the pericope a concrete model for how separate parts become a protective whole.

Aynı kusurlu yay için belirli bir toplulukta kullanılan farklı biçim.

Bir şeyden çıkma veya onun tarafından yetiştirilme nedeniyle çocuk adıyla kurulan aktarılmış bağ.

concept_map.definition: Küçük, ana bütünden dallanmış veya yerden çıkmış bazı şeylerin oğul ya da kız adıyla anılmasıdır; küçük yan yollar, oyuncak insan biçimleri, tapınma yerindeki çakıllar, bir yer taşı ve bir ot türü bu adlandırmanın örnekleridir.

A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.
